title: MEDSYN: Benchmarking Multi-EviDence SYNthesis in Complex Clinical Cases for Multimodal Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Conducting ablation studies (REMOVE-TEXT and RANDOM-TEXT) to observe changes in diagnostic accuracy, and measuring layer-wise Relative Attention per Token (RAPT) to quantify the models' overreliance on linguistic signals versus visual clinical evidence.

Evaluating and comparing model performance (differential diagnosis coverage rates and final diagnosis selection accuracy) across English and Chinese clinical case subsets to identify cross-lingual disparities.
